title: Complete path semantics
prompt: Using the bundled graph_paths reference domain, formalize and test the claim that the two listed intended paths are complete for this directed graph. Vertices: s, a, b, x, t1, t2. Arcs: s->a, a->x, s->b, b->x, x->t1, x->t2. Source: s. Terminals: t1 and t2. Intended paths: s-a-x-t1 and s-b-x-t2. Validate the claim, evaluate the candidate, search for a defeating witness, and independently verify any witness with the compatible authorized checker.
